note: Spring Boot: the VesperaClient bean, vespera.bridge.native.* forwarding, vespera.bridge.library-name init and shutdown-on-close now come from the new web-agnostic VesperaBridgeCoreAutoConfiguration, so non-web applications (spring.main.web-application-type=none) get them too; bean names and @ConditionalOnMissingBean semantics are unchanged. Tests or slices that list VesperaBridgeAutoConfiguration / VesperaBridgeReactiveAutoConfiguration explicitly must add VesperaBridgeCoreAutoConfiguration
